simple.inThisVerse: The selected word is tied to לֶתֶךְ (H3963) in the Hebrew source text. Part of speech: n-m.
simple.whyItMatters: This word is connected to the original Hebrew source text, so BibleIQ can explain it from the underlying word rather than only the English translation.
simple.summary: לֶתֶךְ (lethek) means a measure for things dry First listed occurrence: Hos 3 2.

definitions.full: H3963. lethek לֶ֫תֶךְ noun [masculine] a barley-measure (Late Hebrew id. , a corn-measure); only in וְל ׳חֹמֶרשְֿׂעֹרִים שְׂעֹרִים Hosea 3:2 ; according to ᵑ9 = 1/2 כֹּר = 1/2 חֹמֶר (q. v.), compare Mishna (Levy NHWB ii. 531 ), but this tradition is uncertain (compare Now Archaeology i. 203 ); ᵐ5 νέβελ οἴνου , for ׳ל ׳שׂ .
definitions.rootNote: from an unused root of uncertain meaning;
